items.html: Behold, there are no Mochin less than three aspects, which are Chochma, Bina, and Daat. Chochma is the line of Chesed, Bina is the line of Gevura, and Daat is divided into two: half Chesed and half Gevura, to decide between them, in the secret of “for the Lord is a God of knowledge” — two kinds of knowledge, as it is written. Indeed, Chesed is the aspect of five Chasadim, and Gevura is five Gevurot, as mentioned in the Idra of Naso, p. 142.
